notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: We've noticed and fixed a few bugs. Please let us know if you see any.

notes.title: Buckshot to Hell Available Now!
notes.notes:
There are many bug fixes in the game. If there are any bugs we missed,please do not forget to let us know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004867/5421348d1ee2a14855f9d55a92c3730cad3c70ee.jpg[/img]

This is our first multiplayer game experience, we had a lot of problems but we gained experience. We believe that we will be more successful in our future games.

Please let us know if there are things you don't like about the game or things that should be included. People's opinions are important to us.

Have fun!
